title: Aligning LLM Agents by Learning Latent Preference from User Edits

defines.name: PRELUDE
defines.definition: A learning framework that infers a user's latent preference description from historic edit data and uses it to prompt future response generation.

defines.name: CIPHER
defines.definition: An algorithm that infers context-specific user preferences from edits and retrieves nearby past preferences to form an aggregate preference for generation.

problem: LLM agents are not well aligned to individual users, and fine-tuning from costly preference feedback does not naturally exploit the rich signal in user edits.
